value.rationale: This natural exact combinatorial invariant refines classical square avoidance in canonical substitution blocks and resolves a sharp question of which cyclic cuts least expose repetitions. The circular length spectrum, mean and especially unique two-cut minimizers convey structural information beyond the known square-root catalog. The fixed local-to-global equality mechanism is broadly motivated, not a generic tiny table or routine substitution.
